# TaskSetTimeSlice

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Sets how long a task runs before same-priority tasks get a turn.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0C` SVC_MANAGETASK | `MNGTASK_SET_TIMESLICE (4)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err TaskSetTimeSlice(Handle h, uint32_t slice_us);
```

**Registers:** `(task, slice_us) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Task handle with PERM_CNTL, or -1 for the caller. |
| `slice_us` | in | Slice length in microseconds, within [TIMESLICE_MIN_US, TIMESLICE_MAX_US]. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `slice_us` is out of range. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `h` is not a task. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `h` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
